Question B-003-018-008.

Why the correct answer is right: The safe response is to remove power first, get emergency help, and give first aid only when it is safe to approach.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "Turn off the power, call for emergency help and provide first aid if needed": This is the correct choice because the safe response is to remove power first, get emergency help, and give first aid only when it is safe to approach.
